fields.title: 📖 Shirk in distress: help belongs to Allah alone
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah** explained:

> ***“Ibn Taymiyyah explained that the Muslims, in times of distress, call upon Allah alone and do not refer their needs back to anyone else.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Distress is a test of Tawḥīd. Precisely when a person is weak, it becomes clear whether his heart calls upon Allah alone.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā, Bd. 27, Masʾalah: Yastaghīth ar-Rajul bi-Mayyit aw Ghāʾib.
